events.expected_outcome: Expect tls-handshake-probe to fail, because the retired protocol version is disabled.

episodes.decision_text: Run the link checker on the operations runbook site before adding redirects, to list exactly which links the move breaks.

events.description: Ran the link checker on the branch without redirects.

events.expected_outcome: This should go red on docs:linkcheck, since moved pages have no redirects yet.

events.expected_outcome: This should go red on test_archive_keeps_duplicate_timestamp_rows, since the archive cursor compares timestamps with a strict greater-than.
